scope: Theorem 5.4 (Distribution tests) of the manuscript “A counterexample to the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-Colin-de-Verdiere-chromatic-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 97677c7a183884f0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 34-35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant ηcol > 0, depending only on the early parameters and M, with the following property. Fix any L < ∞ after ηcol and before the selector and channel parameters; choose all remaining parameters in the order of Equation (4.4) and Section A. For every sufficiently large n, the law π constructed above satisfies both conclusions. 34 (i) Let (A, c) have a probability law on units marked by a colour in any fixed finite palette. The colour may be randomized conditional on A. Write σ1, σ2 for the endpoint marginals of its projected unit law σ, and suppose σ1 ≤ Mπ, σ2 ≤ Mπ, σ ≤ 23000gN π2 , Pr(c = j) ≤ ηcol for every j. (5.8) For two independent draws (A, c), (B, c′), Pr(A ▷◁ B, c ̸= c′ ) ≥ 2−100gN . (ii) Let A have a unit law σ and let z be an independent point with law θ, where σ1 ≤ Lπ, σ2 ≤ Lπ, σ ≤ 23000gN π2 , θ ≤ Lπ. (5.9) Then Pr(A ▷◁ z) ≥ 2−100gN . The threshold for n may depend on the fixed palette and on L. All inequalities between measures are pointwise on their finite spaces.
